entry.title: Quantum State Classification Using QNN
entry.content:
Quantum State Classification Using QNN

This project implements parameterised quantum circuits (PQCs) and quantum neural networks for entanglement and separability classification of multi-qubit quantum states. Developed in collaboration with Thirumalai and Diksha Sharma.

View Repository on GitHub

📌 Key Highlights

  • Variational Architectures: Designs and tests ansatz structures optimized for state classification tasks.
  • Entanglement Detection: High-accuracy boundary identification distinguishing entangled from separable state geometries.
  • Noise Resilience: Evaluated under depolarizing and amplitude damping noise channels on simulated backends.

entry.title: Quantum Battery Hamiltonian Simulations
entry.content:
Quantum Battery Hamiltonian Simulations

Open-source numerical simulations of many-body quantum battery systems investigating charging dynamics, extractable work (ergotropy), and capacity speedup enabled by Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction (DMI) and Heisenberg XXZ couplings.

View Repository on GitHub

📌 Key Highlights

  • Spin Chain Networks: Simulates finite-size spin-1/2 Heisenberg spin chains driven by external charging fields.
  • DMI Effects: Demonstrates how asymmetric exchange interactions boost charging power and suppress energy backflow.
  • Ergotropy Analysis: Quantifies maximal work extraction using unitaries applied to the charged battery state.

entry.title: Quantum States Data Set
entry.content:
Quantum States Data Set

This open dataset provides multi-qubit density matrices categorized by their separability and entanglement characteristics, specially formatted for benchmarking quantum machine learning models, state classifiers, and entanglement witnesses.

View Repository on GitHub

📊 Dataset Contents

  • Two-Qubit States: Werner states, Horodecki states, Bell diagonal states, and Maximally Entangled Mixed States (MEMS).
  • Three-Qubit States: Genuine tripartite entangled states (GHZ, W), biseparable states, and fully separable states.
  • Parameters Provided: Density matrices ($\rho$), concurrence, negativity, purity, and entanglement spectrum eigenvalues.
